scalable_extension.correctness_smoke: One case per run, both installed hosts, 1 cold/1 warm after 1 warmup; functional execution only
scalable_extension.truth: Candidate-free stdlib algorithms regenerate and compare every input/expected byte and the retained generator. Original fixtures remain unchanged.
worker_extensions: build_artifact_presence from actual files before Save
saved_artifacts for every named output after each Save
scalable_extension.acceptance: Exact copied root cells/types/order/binary64 bits, empty issues/null logs, independently declared node/source ledgers, zero published files after Build, complete Build/two Save observations, successful Save returns, exact artifact identities/order/columns/rows/bytes. Prospective report artifacts are retained without interpreting them as publication.
scalable_extension.remaining: Approved-size capacity, qualified candidate/baseline characterization, phase and actual callback instrumentation, additional memory providers, and numeric budgets remain open. This extension does not close B17/B18.
scalable_extension.representative_scope: independent truth child before every case; all 21 installed tuples in dispatched performance.yml; source-built previous release archive/wheel retained; no unsupported baseline API becomes a timing sample
scalable_extension.optional_callback_observer: once-delegating signature-preserving installed callable wrapper; full independent parameter/result trace; ordinary and observer complete normalized reports and both held Saves must agree; observer child never counts toward characterization
scalable_extension.host_view_access_counts: actual output/issues/log getter invocations; not internal allocation/copy estimates
scalable_extension.retention_compression: characterization retains views, raw reports and copied saved bytes as lossless gzip members; decompressed original bytes decide independent acceptance. Clocks and compression are separate boundaries; public work files remain ordinary original files.

scope.b17: remaining broader workload/measurement evidence is open
scope.b18: workload sizes/sampling/baseline approved; numeric budgets and remaining machine/metric decisions remain open
scope.performance_claim: correctness-smoke retains raw durations but supplies no characterization

first_explicit_native_call: first public Build after resolving/importing the facade; compiled core metadata is read after Build; no engine_info probe
initialization_limits: Package import may load the native library; shipped-schema and OS filesystem caches are uncontrolled. The controller does not time process startup.
controller_dependencies: Unix ps or Windows PowerShell process inventory

python: installed yamaa and its declared runtime dependencies

r_clock_admission: Retained selected source-build config, built timer library and byte-identical installed timer library; declared/actual collector version and origin. Windows WIN32/QueryPerformanceCounter; macOS MB_HAVE_MACH_TIME/mach_absolute_time; clock_gettime only with CLOCK_MONOTONIC, CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW or CLOCK_MONOTONIC_PRECISE. Wall-clock fallback refused. Source config/library relationship is retained build attestation, not inferred from OS or sampled time.
r_collector_bootstrap: Collector import and request JSON decoding precede the yamaa import timer and are explicitly retained. Only raw microbenchmark::get_nanotime is called; no expression wrapper, implicit warmup or overhead subtraction.
r_timestamp_representation: Each raw start_ns/end_ns/duration_ns is an object containing decimal (17 significant-digit round-trip string) and binary64_bits (exact big-endian IEEE binary64 bytes), under representation=binary64-nanoseconds. Controller checks decimal/bytes identity and exact binary64 subtraction; no integer coercion, tolerance, overhead adjustment or elapsed repair. Ordinary JSON numeric rounding is not accepted as the raw R clock representation.
compilation_exclusion: Explicit --compilation-clear caller attestation plus process-name inventory before every child; unavailable inventory refuses. This is not an atomic system-wide lock; caller keeps compilation stopped throughout.
timing_limits: Outer boundaries include the actual public call or copying/canonical transport. Raw observation transport, saved-byte copying and controller acceptance run outside those timers. Import is once per child, warm import duration is not assigned to each repeat.
provenance_limit: Source/artifact association comes from a retained installation qualification record. Workers verify actual loaded package/native origins and runtime/package/core versions after Build; the engine does not encode an introspectable source revision. Current cargo is not substituted for artifact build toolchain. Supplied Python wheel native bytes are compared directly with the actual installed library. Supplied source archives are compared with every original native source/manifest/lock/toolchain member; final source-built binary association still uses the retained build/installation attestation.
original_truth: Controller reads unchanged Git yaml schema tree, all three benchmark case trees and original complete report JSON directly. Expected copied values/types/order/IEEE binary64 bits are projected from the original derived tables using original artifact column order. Only original runtime identity placeholders, public example label and requested specification labels are replaced. Original report artifact content equals original CSV bytes. These schema originals are retained and checked directly; the ordinary installed engine uses its embedded shipped schemas, with their generated native source pinned by archive/source qualification. No custom schema loader is passed to public Build.
correctness_before_accepting: outside all checkout origins, including resolved symlinks
declared source/artifact/runtime provenance matches retained installation and actual worker observations
complete Build report with unsaved artifacts
copied output and post-Save output types/order/cells/float bits and actual host schema
both original CSV byte comparisons and native held repeated bytes
both original successful Save return values
fresh work directory and new ordinary Domain per repetition
retained_layout: originals/ unchanged Git schema/cases/reports and byte comparison list
harness/ exact executed controller/protocol/worker bytes with checkout head separate from installed source
{host}-installation/ declared JSON, installation record, artifact bytes and R clock build evidence
{child}/request.json fresh work directories for every declared repetition
failure_policy: No retries or skipped failures. Controller retains worker/startup/acceptance failures and continues remaining declared children when possible. Warm workers retain each declared repetition on ordinary failure; interruptions stop and preserve reached/unreached steps. Any missing/incomplete/failing repetition or warmup rejects the collection. Null/unreached metrics are never replaced by zero. Retain reached Build observations before metadata. Save finally safely retains latest owner observations and any available published bytes even on a throwing Save; secondary evidence_capture_failures are separate from the original public cause and also reject acceptance. Final response transport is protected: emit the primary diagnostic before writing, clear the owned result even if transport fails, emit a separate secondary transport diagnostic, stop that child without retry, and retain the last partial response plus stderr; missing final evidence rejects acceptance.

rss.scope: whole child lifetime including imports, copies and raw evidence writes; cumulative across warm repetitions, excludes parent/controller acceptance; sampled at end of each repetition

controller_child_lifetime.launch: fresh small broker excludes large generator/controller fork RSS
controller_child_lifetime.retention: process.json preserves child identity, exit status and actual observation; unavailable provider never becomes zero
controller_child_lifetime.qualification: actual Linux allocation and parent-isolation controls; macOS/Windows require installed CI evidence

prohibited: callback-count inference from handler names/report arrays
b17/b18 closure or release transition claims
harness_identity: Truth source_revision and truth_repository_head are separate from the harness surrounding checkout_head (null outside Git). Retained executed controller/protocol/worker bytes are authoritative; a surrounding checkout commit does not prove untracked or modified harness bytes.
native_call_order_limit: Worker order records the public Build and subsequent metadata anchors; private held-owner observation transport runs after Build outside timers and is not an actual callback/native-call count.
worker_executable_admission: Launch the caller's absolute lexical executable spelling to preserve Python pyvenv.cfg context; independently resolve/audit its real target and reject invocation or actual target inside a checkout. Actual loaded package/native origins and versions are checked after public Build.
